forum.title: CubeMX2 Middleware no usbx and netx etc
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @ShimiaoWang

For the first release of the Embedded Software for C5 the **FileX, LevelX, USBX, and LwIP**is unfortunately not supported by STM32CubeMX2, but a the support is planned to come latest early Q3 this year.

For inspiration for using USBx there are still available example that you can find here: <https://dev.st.com/stm32-example-library/result?filters=N4IgpgHghgtgDgGzAOVmEAuA2gXQDQgwDGArprgQEYD2UATgCbn6ECWDDSA7vetiAFUAygCEAGiBbESAETqsAbmDrMqtRgAUoRANZQA5nwogG8pXQAqATzhGcAXyA>

Best Regards,

Emil
forum.content_text:
There is no USBX or other middleware in my cubemx2, but the connection introduction indicates that it is available.

[How to access middleware & utilities - STM32CubeMX2 1.0.0 documentation](https://dev.st.com/stm32cube-docs/stm32cubemx2/1.0.0/en/docs/markup/CubeMX2_How_To/CubeMX2_How_To_Acces_MW.html)
